title: Potato Tempura Casserole
description: A delicious Japanese-inspired casserole featuring crispy potato tempura, topped with a light and fluffy egg mixture.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 180°C.
Dredge the potato slices in flour, shaking off excess.
Fry the potatoes in batches until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per batch.
Drain the tempura on paper towels.
In a separate pan, sauté the cubed bread until lightly toasted.
In a large bowl, whisk together the beaten eggs, sake, and soy sauce (if using).
In a greased 20cm square baking dish, create a layer of tempura potatoes.
Top with a layer of toasted bread, followed by a layer of crushed casserole.
Repeat this process until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of tempura potatoes on top.
Pour the egg mixture over the potatoes and smooth the surface.
Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 25-30 minutes, or until the egg is set and golden brown.
